Part of the problem with this worldview is that the "75% of Americans who say restaurants should be kid free because of screaming children" aren't actually surrounded by legitimately screaming children 99% of the time.

Yes, gentle parenting is a problem that needs addressing, & kids should not be completely unruly... but nothing has shocked me more as a new parent than seeing pessimistic adults' visceral reaction to my baby making a single noise in public and angrily calling it "screaming." 

I
I don't know who needs to hear this today but kids belong in public spaces.

They say as you get older your birthday is just another normal day.

Thank you, God, for our “normal” days living in the days we used to pray for!!

My 28th year was unforgettable—but I’ve got an incredible feeling about 29.

Thank you all for the sweet birthday wishes, for supporting our little family, and being an active part of our little corner of the Internet. We love you more than you know!!
